unmapped_findings: Product of strength and elongation (PSE) for S2 austempered at 350 °C is 12,970 MPa·% (≈13.0 GPa·%), the peak performance of alloy S2 (Sections 3.3 and 4).
S2 bainitic transformation kinetics at TB 350 °C: incubation time 210 s and bainite finish time Bt ≈ 2300 s; at TB 300 °C: incubation 130 s and Bt = 3600 s.
S2 measured Ms = 274 °C, measured TA = 1031 °C, MatCalc ferrite-free TA = 929 °C, applied TA = 1150 °C (Table 2 / Fig. 4).

S2 (with ~0.1 wt.% higher C than S1) showed only minor mechanical differences from S1: at 300 °C S2 gave UTS ~1590 MPa and El 7.0 % (PSE 11,130 MPa·%) — this belongs to the sibling 300 °C condition, not the 350 °C sample.
Some studies relate Al addition to accelerating bainitic transformation; S1 and S2 behave similarly with higher C shifting bainitic transformation onset toward lower temperatures.
General observation: 8.08 wt.% Al design (S3) is detrimental to ductility at lower TB; C variations near 1 wt.% are secondary to Al level; Ti+Ni alloying in S4 compensates for lower C.
